items.title: Package and review the fixed T480 A1 deployment adapter
evidence: 2026-09-14: scripts/a1_t480_deploy.py packages the exact reviewed A1 source closure into a deterministic regular-file tar manifest and defines only package, inspect, and bounded deploy operations. Package check produced archive sha256:c7540e541b503ef58b0c8e04ebc91fcc5bca49ffffe00dafa1e87d7a56bc6fc8 with manifest sha256:fb60ecd125669b14136ac7e12ba0c042de4045a1e0ba41120ac3190d71f74cc8 and 15 bound files; no T480 operation was run.

2026-09-14: Terra repair attempt 1 addressed Astra's archive/permissions/output findings. The adapter preflights the existing fixed service before staging, verifies every unique regular tar member against the manifest before extraction, builds with stdout suppressed, sets the dedicated bind store to UID/GID 65532 and mode 0700 through a no-network one-shot container, and emits only final machine-readable service JSON. It stores non-secret credential/workflow IDs and the exported workflow hash in a protected recovery state; existing state or environment files refuse mutation for explicit recovery. n8n IDs must be present strings matching the fixed identifier syntax. No T480 operation was run.

2026-09-14: Terra repair attempt 2 reduced transfer chunks to 4 KiB. Every chunk is measured through cs-ai-lab-infra's actual WSL/PowerShell/SSH encoding and must remain at or below the 32,767-character Windows argument limit (representative measured command: 20,325). The isolated ownership helper retains only CHOWN and FOWNER after dropping all capabilities. It writes protected recovery state immediately after credential creation and again immediately after workflow creation, before the configured-workflow GET/export; later network failure leaves exact IDs for explicit recovery rather than permitting a duplicate. A script-level fake-T480 regression forces the export GET to fail and confirms credential/workflow IDs persist while no service environment exists. No T480 operation was run.

2026-09-14: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_a1_t480_deploy.py tests/test_bls_n8n_workflow.py tests/test_bls_n8n_service.py tests/test_bls_n8n_retention.py tests/test_bls_n8n_projection.py passed (31 tests). Tests cover deterministic manifest, altered/extra archive rejection, symlink/traversal refusal, bounded limits, real shared-encoding command bound, fixed network/no public ports, T480-only secret generation, response redaction, partial failure recovery state, and non-mutating fixed-name inspection. Independent Astra re-review remains required before deployment.
